title: Launch, share and keep your portfolio fresh
course_title: Online Portfolio Building: Show Your Best Work and Win Clients

say: Launch, share, and keep your portfolio fresh.
This is the video for module four of Online Portfolio Building.
The most common reason portfolios never launch is that the project drags on for months. A short plan fixes that.

say: A link with no explanation looks like spam, and many people are rightly careful about unknown links.

panel.heading: Never send a bare link
right: Who you are and why you write

say: For example, Amaka replies to a price enquiry: here are six of my children's birthday cakes, with what each customer asked for. Themed cakes start from approximately 35,000 naira. What theme does your child love?
A reason to click, what they will see, and a next step.

say: Here is a quarterly review. Grace's tracker shows 18 enquiries in three months. 11 mentioned the portfolio, and most asked about bridal bead sets.
So she swaps her two weakest everyday necklaces for two stronger bridal sets, and puts the best bridal set first. She also changes her headline to bridal and occasion bead sets.
Her old price guide said bridal sets from approximately 18,000 naira.
Her bead supplier raised prices, so she updates it to approximately 22,000, and saves a PDF of the old and new versions.

After every good job, take photos, ask permission and a testimonial, and write three lines. That takes 15 to 20 minutes. Monthly, check your tracker and buttons. Every three months, read it all as a stranger and update prices and links.

panel.heading: Your update routine
items: After each good job: photos, permission, 3 lines
Monthly: check tracker, swap a weaker piece
Every 3 months: full review, prices, links
New piece replaces the weakest one
Back up to Google Drive
Two-step verification on

say: A new piece goes in only if it is as strong as your weakest one, and then it replaces it. That keeps your selection tight.

say: Protect it too. Keep originals in Google Drive, use a password you use nowhere else, and turn on two-step verification. If someone takes over your account, they can change your contact button to their own number.

say: To remember. Build in seven days, about an hour a day, and publish when the checklist passes. Put your link everywhere your customers look, and always introduce it.
Update monthly, and protect the account that holds your portfolio.
